sections.text: Introduction

This document outlines the equipment inspection checklist I1,
to be performed on an annually bases as indicated by Y1 in the title block.

The first draft is initiated by eng. Ahmad Al-Okabi, tested by 
eng. Tarek EL-kafafy, accepted by general director eng. Nady Mosaed, approved by 
eng. Mohamed EL-Tahawy Head sector of Shoubra EL-Kheima PS.

This document revised by eng. Nageh Soliman Shousha, CEPC quality control director, and certified by 
eng. Afaf Ebrahim El-Dib,
CEPC inspection & quality control 's head sector and MPIS coordinator
Safety Precautions

items:
A
 work permit must be issued and the qualified maintenance staff should
 carry the suitable safety category

Wear
 your safety helmet & safety shoes.

Safety
 fence with caution marks surrounding the work area.

Unit
 outage is required

The
 transformer must be isolated and grounded from the two 
 sides

sections.text: Work to be Carried Out
Make visual inspection for painting and leakage .

Check the transformer control panel and
use blower for cleaning it .

Check breather ,
change the silica gel if the color is pink or white and adjust oil level in the trap of air dryer .

Check and inspect the good operation of
fire fighting system .

Check oil level in conservator (add if
necessary) .
Check ground wire and tighten it if necessary .

Measure De-electric voltage of oil (40 Kv
/ 2.5 mm) .
Measure acid value of oil (less than 0.2 , acceptable) .

Analyze gases in oil (dissolved
combustible gases less than 700 ppm) .
Measure water content (Less than 40 ppm) .

Measure winding insulation resistance
(including bushing ) , to be in accordance with fig.
(1) and table (1) .

Measure the HV and LV
windings resistance , in accordance with tables (2) .

Measure the voltage ratio bet HV &
LV, in accordance with table (3).

Check No-voltage tap changer can smoothly
be changed over with light cricks.

Check bushing (pipe cracks 
contamination including saline oil leakage rust formation).

Check protective control circuit (tests
of relays pressure setting , oil flow level , dial
thermometer , cooler power supply , visually check wire) .
Check pressure release device (Cracks, oil or gas leak, break of safety pin) .

Check mechanical protective relay
(buchhloz relay) .

Check winding temp. equipment
.

Check cooling fans motors (bearing and
megger group circuit)

Check oil pumps for leakage and measure
the insulation resistance of winding of their motors .

Get the transformer into 
service.
